claim: John the Baptist was a real figure, executed by Herod Antipas.

bible.note: Herod has John beheaded after a banquet.
John preaches and baptizes in the Jordan region.

outside.note: Describes John as a good man who urged people to live justly and be baptized, and says Herod had him killed at Machaerus.

counter: The reason for the execution differs. Josephus gives a political motive (fear of unrest) while the Gospels point to Herod’s marriage. Both can be true, but the difference should be stated.
